title: Trainee - Civil Construction / Water utilities
abstract: Larrakia Bilirra Group PTY LTD is a respected provider of services within the trades and construction sector.
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
What's your expected annual base salary?
How many years' experience do you have in a Civil Construction Role?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
content_text:
About the role
Larrakia Bilirra Group Pty Ltd is seeking enthusiastic and motivated Trainees for the Water & Civil Industry to join our growing team in Melbourne. This is a full-time position offering an excellent opportunity to launch your career in the trades and services sector. As a trainee, you will work alongside experienced professionals, gaining hands-on experience and developing practical skills in water and civil construction projects. This role is fundamental to building your foundation in the industry and contributing to the successful delivery of our projects.
What you'll be doing
- Assisting experienced tradespeople and supervisors on our existing contracts at Melbourne Water, South East Water, Central Highlands Water, Yarra Valley Water and local councils.
- Performing manual labour tasks including site preparation, material handling, and equipment operation under supervision
- Maintaining a clean and safe work environment in accordance with site safety standards and procedures
- Learning and applying best practices in water and civil industry techniques and methodologies
- Operating hand tools and basic power tools safely and effectively
- Supporting the completion of tasks related to drainage, cleaning drainage systems and associated civil infrastructure networks
- Maintaining accurate records and reporting on daily activities and site conditions
- Adhering to all health, safety and environmental regulations on site
- Assisting with the transportation and storage of materials and equipment
- Attending and actively participating in on-site toolbox meetings and training sessions
What we're looking for
- A genuine desire to learn and develop a career in the water and civil industry
- Physical fitness and the ability to perform manual labour in various weather conditions
- Strong work ethic, reliability and punctuality
- Excellent communication and teamwork skills
- A commitment to health and safety practices on construction sites
- A valid White Card
- A valid driver's licence
- The ability to follow instructions and work effectively under supervision
- Problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to tasks
- No prior experience required – we welcome school leavers and career changers seeking a traineeship opportunity
What we offer
- Structured traineeship programme with comprehensive on-the-job training and mentoring from experienced professionals
- Competitive wages and penalty rates in accordance with industry standards
- Access to professional development and skills training opportunities to advance your career
- A supportive and inclusive team environment where your contributions are valued
- Full-time employment security and potential for permanent roles upon successful completion of your traineeship
- Health and wellbeing support services for our employees
- Safe working conditions with a strong commitment to workplace safety
- Opportunities for career progression within the water and civil industry
About us
Larrakia Bilirra Group PTY LTD is a respected provider of services within the trades and construction sector, with a strong presence in the water and civil industry across Victoria. We are committed to delivering high-quality projects whilst maintaining the highest standards of safety, professionalism and environmental responsibility. Our team is built on the values of integrity, teamwork and continuous improvement. We believe in investing in our people and creating pathways for talented individuals to build rewarding careers in the trades. As an equal opportunity employer, we celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive workplace where all employees can thrive.
Apply now
If you are ready to start your journey in the water and civil industry, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your resume, a cover letter outlining your interest in this traineeship, and any relevant certifications. Join our team and become part of a company that invests in your future and supports your professional growth.
